itinerary.title: Canton, GA to Little Rock, AR
itinerary.hotel: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Little Rock-West

hotel_info.parking_note: Oversized & trailer parking available in rear lot; well-lit with easy turning radius
hotel_info.breakfast: Free Hot Express Start Breakfast (6:00 AM – 9:30 AM)

itinerary.target: Direct shortest and fastest transit west via the US-72 / I-269 / I-40 corridor through Huntsville and Memphis, bypassing all Nashville congestion.

legs.name: Morning Stretch
legs.route_details: Canton, GA → 1855 US Highway 72 E, Huntsville, AL 35811 (153 miles, approx. 2 hrs 50 mins)
legs.operational_notes: GA-20 W to Rome, GA and AL-35 / US-72 W through Scottsboro into Huntsville. Gains 1 hour across time zone line (EDT to CDT). Plan a 30-minute staging and fueling break at RaceTrac Travel Plaza upon arrival.

legs.name: Midday Run
legs.route_details: 1855 US Highway 72 E, Huntsville, AL 35811 → 4740 Bethel Rd, Olive Branch, MS 38654 (185 miles, approx. 3 hrs 10 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Direct four-lane transit on US-72 W past Athens, Florence, and Corinth into northern Mississippi to Flying J Travel Center #677 at I-269 / Bethel Rd. Plan a 30-minute lunch and fueling break.

legs.name: Evening Stretch
legs.route_details: 4740 Bethel Rd, Olive Branch, MS 38654 → 4900 Talley Road, Little Rock, AR 72204 (155 miles, approx. 2 hrs 25 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Fastest leg taking I-269 to I-55 across the Mississippi River, connecting directly to I-40 W into Little Rock and I-430 S (Exit 4). Arrives at the hotel destination at 4:25 PM with over 3 hours of daylight remaining.
legs.destination_name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Little Rock-West

itinerary.title: Little Rock, AR to Tucumcari, NM

hotel_info.parking_note: Wide perimeter parking suitable for trucks & trailers; easy pull-through access

itinerary.target: Clear Oklahoma City bottleneck during the mid-day commuter dead zone.

legs.name: Morning Stretch
legs.route_details: 4900 Talley Rd, Little Rock, AR 72204 → 903 E Trudgeon St, Henryetta, OK 74437 (248 miles, approx. 3 hrs 35 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Early departure avoids local Little Rock morning commuter buildup. Staging and fueling break at QuikTrip (Exit 237).
legs.start_name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Little Rock-West

legs.name: Midday Run
legs.route_details: 903 E Trudgeon St, Henryetta, OK 74437 → 301 S 4th St, Sayre, OK 73662 (218 miles, approx. 3 hrs 12 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Passes through the heart of Oklahoma City at approximately 11:15 AM, hitting the optimal lunch-hour lull. Plan a 30-minute break at Southbound Quickstop (Phillips 66) at Exit 20.

legs.name: Evening Stretch
legs.route_details: 301 S 4th St, Sayre, OK 73662 → 1901 S Mountain Rd, Tucumcari, NM 88401 (239 miles, approx. 3 hrs 27 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Straightforward tracking along I-40 W directly into the Day 2 overnight hotel location (Fairfield Inn & Suites). Gains 1 hour across time zone line (CDT to MDT).
legs.destination_name: Fairfield Inn & Suites by Marriott Tucumcari

itinerary.title: Tucumcari, NM to Winslow, AZ

hotel_info.parking_note: Spacious commercial & trailer parking on side lot; easy turning radius right off I-40 (Exit 253)
hotel_info.breakfast: Complimentary Full Hot Breakfast (6:00 AM – 9:30 AM)

itinerary.target: Traverse Albuquerque mid-day and cross into the dry Arizona plateau for a relaxing evening in historic Winslow.

legs.name: Morning Stretch
legs.route_details: 1901 S Mountain Rd, Tucumcari, NM 88401 → 650 Juan Tabo Blvd NE, Albuquerque, NM 87123 (167 miles, approx. 2 hrs 25 mins)
legs.operational_notes: A slightly delayed departure allows Albuquerque's morning rush hour to dissolve entirely before your arrival. 30-minute fueling break at Maverik #621.
legs.destination_address: 650 Juan Tabo Boulevard NE, Albuquerque, NM 87123

legs.name: Midday Run
legs.route_details: 650 Juan Tabo Blvd NE, Albuquerque, NM 87123 → 3540 E Historic Hwy 66, Gallup, NM 87301 (141 miles, approx. 2 hrs 03 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Navigates the multi-lane highway splits of the city during clear mid-day traffic. Crosses Continental Divide (7,275 ft). Plan a 30-minute break at Maverik #535.
legs.start_address: 650 Juan Tabo Boulevard NE, Albuquerque, NM 87123

legs.name: Evening Stretch
legs.route_details: 3540 E Historic Hwy 66, Gallup, NM 87301 → 816 Transcon Ln, Winslow, AZ 86047 (128 miles, approx. 1 hr 50 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Scenic Route 66 corridor drive into Winslow, AZ. Note: Crossing into Arizona gains 1 hour (MDT to MST/AZ), bringing local hotel arrival to 02:48 PM MST with plenty of daylight to relax at Best Western Plus.
amenities: Standin' on the Corner Park Nearby

itinerary.title: Winslow, AZ to Tehachapi, CA

hotel_info.parking_note: Spacious commercial & trailer parking on south lot with easy turning lane access

itinerary.target: Front-load the longest driving stretch in the cool morning, cruise the Mojave midday, and finish with a quick climb into Tehachapi.

legs.name: Morning Stretch
legs.route_details: 816 Transcon Ln, Winslow, AZ 86047 → 14875 AZ-95, Lake Havasu City, AZ 86404 (245 miles, approx. 3 hrs 30 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Long, productive morning run down the I-40 corridor past Flagstaff, Williams, and Kingman to the Colorado River valley. Plan a 30-minute fueling & lunch stop at Love's Travel Stop #386 (Exit 9).

legs.name: Midday Run
legs.route_details: 14875 AZ-95, Lake Havasu City, AZ 86404 → 2974 Lenwood Rd, Barstow, CA 92311 (165 miles, approx. 2 hrs 25 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Comfortable medium midday stretch crossing the Colorado River into California on I-40 W across the Mojave Desert. Easy off/on at Lenwood Rd. Plan a 30-minute break at Love's Travel Stop #374.
legs.timezone_change: Enter CA / PDT (Same as AZ in Summer)

legs.name: Evening Stretch
legs.route_details: 2974 Lenwood Rd, Barstow, CA 92311 → 422 W Tehachapi Blvd, Tehachapi, CA 93561 (90 miles, approx. 1 hr 25 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Quick final sprint transitioning off I-15/I-40 onto CA-58 W through Mojave and climbing up into the Tehachapi Pass hotel (Fairfield Inn & Suites). Early arrival before 4:00 PM.
legs.destination_name: Fairfield Inn & Suites by Marriott Tehachapi

itinerary.title: Tehachapi, CA to Redding, CA

hotel_info.parking_note: Extended pull-through bays on north side for trailers & convoy staging
hotel_info.breakfast: Complimentary Full Hot Breakfast (6:00 AM – 9:00 AM)

itinerary.target: Front-load the Central Valley run, glide through Sacramento during the midday lull, and enjoy a quick sprint into Redding.

legs.name: Morning Stretch
legs.route_details: 422 W Tehachapi Blvd, Tehachapi, CA 93561 → 29025 W Plaza Dr, Santa Nella, CA 95322 (213 miles, approx. 3 hrs 15 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Early departure down CA-58 past Bakersfield onto I-5 North through the Central Valley. Plan a 30-minute fueling break at Love's Travel Stop #566 (Exit 407).
legs.destination_address: 29025 West Plaza Drive, Santa Nella, CA 95322

legs.name: Midday Run
legs.route_details: 29025 W Plaza Dr, Santa Nella, CA 95322 → 100 Marguerite St, Williams, CA 95987 (171 miles, approx. 2 hrs 35 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Passes directly through Sacramento between 11:30 AM – 12:15 PM during the optimal midday commuter lull. Easy off/on at Exit 578. Plan a 30-minute fueling & lunch break at Love's Travel Stop #652.
legs.start_address: 29025 West Plaza Drive, Santa Nella, CA 95322

legs.name: Evening Stretch
legs.route_details: 100 Marguerite St, Williams, CA 95987 → 1195 Grand Ave, Redding, CA 96003 (104 miles, approx. 1 hr 32 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Clear, open rural drive northbound through Willows, Corning, and Anderson into the Redding hotel (Comfort Suites Redding). Relaxed afternoon arrival by 02:52 PM with views of Mt. Shasta.

itinerary.title: Redding, CA to Canyonville, OR
itinerary.target: Secure optimal visibility and warmer road conditions through mountain passes.

legs.name: Final Leg
legs.route_details: 1195 Grand Ave, Redding, CA 96003 → 561 Mill St, Canyonville, OR 97417 (215 miles, approx. 3 hrs 33 mins)
legs.operational_notes: No urban gridlock risks. Leaving at 09:00 AM maximizes daylight safety, thermal road traction, and line-of-sight visibility over the Siskiyou Pass (4,310 ft) and mountain grades back home.
